_note: Lunar festival dates change every year. These were filled in from memory and MUST be checked against a panchang (see README TODO). Format: YYYY-MM-DD, local date.

blurb.en: The winter bonfire festival: rewri, moongphali and warm songs.
blurb.hinglish: Sardi ka alaav wala tyohaar: rewri, moongphali aur garmaagaram geet.

label.en: Sing a song for baby by the fire
label.hinglish: Aag ke paas baby ke liye geet gaaiye

caution.en: Sit a safe distance from the fire and smoke.
caution.hinglish: Aag aur dhuein se surakshit doori par baithein.

blurb.en: Til-gur, khichdi and the sun moving north.
blurb.hinglish: Til-gur, khichdi aur suraj ka uttarayan.

label.en: Greet the sun with the Gayatri mantra
label.hinglish: Gayatri mantra se suraj ko pranaam

blurb.en: Yellow mustard fields and a prayer to Saraswati for learning.
blurb.hinglish: Peele sarson ke khet aur gyaan ke liye Saraswati vandana.

blurb.en: Colours, gujiya and the story of brave Prahlad.
blurb.hinglish: Rang, gujiya aur bahadur Prahlad ki kahani.

caution.en: Use only gentle natural colours, and stay away from rough play.
caution.hinglish: Sirf halke prakritik rang lagaayein, aur dhakka-mukki se door rahein.

blurb.en: The golden wheat harvest. Thank the earth that feeds us.
blurb.hinglish: Sunehri gehun ki fasal. Dharti ka shukriya jo hume khilaati hai.

label.hinglish: Baby ko fasal ke baare mein bataiye

blurb.en: Swings on the neem tree, mehendi, ghevar and monsoon songs.
blurb.hinglish: Neem par jhoole, mehendi, ghevar aur saawan ke geet.

label.en: Open the Teej swing and sing

caution.en: Enjoy a gentle sit on the swing only; no high swinging this year.
caution.hinglish: Is saal jhoole par sirf halke se baithein; ooncha jhoola nahi.

blurb.en: A thread of love and care between siblings.
blurb.hinglish: Bhai-behen ke beech pyaar aur raksha ka dhaaga.

label.en: Tell baby about your brothers and sisters
label.hinglish: Baby ko apne bhai-behenon ke baare mein bataiye

blurb.en: Baby Krishna's birthday: makhan, mor pankh and jhaanki.
blurb.hinglish: Baal Krishna ka janmdin: makhan, mor pankh aur jhaanki.

label.en: Read Baby Krishna and the butter
label.hinglish: Baal Krishna aur makhan ki kahani

blurb.en: Nine nights of Devi, and the Haryanvi Sanjhi made of clay stars on the wall.
blurb.hinglish: Devi ki nau raatein, aur deewar par mitti ke sitaaron wali Haryanvi Sanjhi.

caution.en: Watch the Ravan dahan from far away, away from crowds and smoke.
caution.hinglish: Ravan dahan door se dekhein, bheed aur dhuein se alag.

blurb.en: A day of love under the moon.
blurb.hinglish: Chaand ke neeche pyaar ka din.

label.en: Tell baby the story of the moon tonight
label.hinglish: Aaj raat baby ko chaand ki kahani sunaiye

caution.en: Fasting during pregnancy is not advised. Please talk to your doctor and keep eating and drinking; love is in the prayer, not the fast.
caution.hinglish: Garbhavastha mein vrat ki salaah nahi di jaati. Doctor se baat karein aur khaana-paani lete rahein; pyaar puja mein hai, bhookh mein nahi.

blurb.en: Mothers pray for their children's wellbeing under the stars.
blurb.hinglish: Maayein taaron ke neeche bachchon ki khushhaali ki dua karti hain.

label.en: Write a letter to your baby

caution.en: Please don't fast during pregnancy. Pray with a full tummy, with your doctor's advice.
caution.hinglish: Garbhavastha mein vrat na rakhein. Doctor ki salaah se, pet bhar kar puja kijiye.

blurb.en: Diyas, rangoli and light for the new life coming.
blurb.hinglish: Diye, rangoli aur aane wale nanhe jeevan ke liye roshni.

caution.en: Stay indoors away from cracker smoke and loud bangs.
caution.hinglish: Pataakhon ke dhuein aur tez awaaz se door, ghar ke andar rahein.

blurb.en: The day the Gita was spoken at Kurukshetra, in our own Haryana.
blurb.hinglish: Woh din jab Kurukshetra mein, hamare Haryana mein, Gita kahi gayi.

label.hinglish: Gita Week ki kahaniyan shuru kijiye
